issues.title: New interaction not shown
issues.body:
I'm logged in as `adjudicator-1`, and the game is in `adjudication phase` (I'll create a branch with the database in this state).

I click on `Get next interaction`.  An interaction is generated, pushed to the database, and when the screen updates I'm shown it, with the form to add outcomes.  The interaction is shows `No` in the `Complete` column.

When I add some outcomes, and push `Submit interaction`, a new version of the interaction is pushed to the database, with `msg.details.interaction.complete` = `true` (but with the same `msg.message.Reference`.   This document gets pushed back to the client, and `adjudication messages list` has fancy processing to detect is has a new version of an existing document - which results in filtering out the previous version, injecting the new copy, and calling `setRows()`.

This all works, but the updated document isn't displayed in the table. It is still shown as `Complete : No`.

Note: if I do an F5 refresh the correct interaction status is shown: `Complete`: `Yes`.

Video recording here:
https://i.gyazo.com/4030e17c2788acd0406be97d817e904d.mp4

I've put in some logging to track the value of the `Complete` field:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/217870965-9e9e3f70-3e1b-4e7e-8019-9124b82b730f.png)

comments.body: Workaround is to only show own/live adjudications
